name: feishu-next
description: Reusable Codex skills for common Feishu/Lark workflows powered by the official lark-cli.

interface.shortDescription: Plugin-first Feishu workflow router and skills for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Feishu Next packages the plugin-first replacement for standalone Feishu lark-cli guide skills plus reusable Codex workflows. It routes Feishu/Lark tasks to the current official lark-cli embedded lark-* skills without vendoring them, then hands stateful work to bundled sub-skills for read-only document export, document asset mapping, IM chat archiving, and whiteboard edit/recovery or draw.io publishing loops with evidence-preserving outputs.
defaultPrompt: Use $feishu-next:feishu-workflow-router to route this Feishu/Lark lark-cli task and decide which official lark-* skill or Feishu Next sub-skill applies.
Use $feishu-next:feishu-whiteboard-ops to update or sync this Feishu whiteboard.
